stem: What is the most likely reason the playwright describes Ben as “out of breath” and “like he just rolled out of bed”?

options.label: A
options.text: To show that Ben relies on help from other people

options.label: B
options.text: To show that Ben is often tired in the morning

options.label: C
options.text: To show that Ben does things at the last possible moment

options.label: D
options.text: To show that Ben cares greatly about his school work

visual_elements: [The setting is Wednesday morning on a school bus. Shruti is seated. Ben enters. He is out of breath and looks like he just rolled out of bed. He is holding a poster board. He sits next to Shruti.]
